lookupStatus.description: `found` when Instagram has the audio, with or without Reels; `not_found` when it doesn't know the id.

id.description: Audio id. The audio endpoints take it as `audioId`, and it matches `audio.id` on a Reel.

assetId.description: A second id Instagram gives some audio, set only when it differs from `id`. If `GET /v2/instagram/audio/{audioId}` answers not_found for an `id` from search, try `assetId`. Null when none.

artistHandle.description: Username of the account behind the audio: the creator of original audio, or the artist's account for licensed music when Instagram links one. Null when none or not reported.

isOriginal.description: Whether it is original audio rather than licensed music.

reelCount.description: Reels using it, as an exact count. Null when Instagram only gives a rounded figure (such as 2.5M).

coverUrl.description: Cover art. Null for original audio. Instagram CDN URL; it expires after a while.

previewUrl.description: Short audio clip of the track. Null for original audio and when Instagram gives none. Instagram CDN URL; it expires after a while.

spotifyUrl.description: Spotify page of the track. Null for original audio and when Instagram links none.

hasLyrics.description: Whether Instagram has lyrics for the track. Null for original audio and when not reported.

audio.description: The song or original sound, on the first page only. Null on later pages (use `GET /v2/instagram/audio/{audioId}` for it at any time) and when `lookupStatus` is `not_found`.

shortcode.description: Shortcode used in the media URL. Null for stories.

url.description: Public URL: `/reel/` for Reels, `/p/` otherwise. Null for stories.

altText.description: Alt text Instagram generated or the owner wrote. Null when none or not reported.

avatarUrl.description: Profile picture. Instagram CDN URL; it expires after a while.

owner.description: The account that posted it. Null when unknown.

likeCount.description: Likes. Null when hidden or not reported.

playCount.description: Plays, for videos. Counts Instagram plays only, not plays of a cross-posted copy on other apps.

likesHidden.description: Whether the owner hides the like count.

metrics.description: Engagement counts. Null when this view doesn't report one.

imageUrl.description: Image, or a video's cover image. Instagram CDN URL; it expires after a while.

thumbnailUrl.description: Small preview image. Instagram CDN URL; it expires after a while.

videoUrl.description: Video file. Instagram CDN URL; it expires after a while.

durationSec.description: Video length in seconds, to the millisecond.

carousel.description: Every item of a carousel, in order. Null when not a carousel.

artistHandle.description: Username of the account behind original audio.

taggedUsers.description: Accounts tagged in the media. Empty when none. Null when this view doesn't carry tags.

isPaidPartnership.description: Whether it is labelled as a paid partnership.

avatarUrl.description: Profile picture. Instagram CDN URL; it expires after a while.

items.description: An Instagram account as it appears on other things.

sponsors.description: Brands named in the paid-partnership label. Empty when it is not a partnership. Null when this view doesn't say.

commentsDisabled.description: Whether the owner turned comments off. Null when this view doesn't say.

isPinned.description: Whether the owner pinned it to their profile (to the Reels tab, when listed there). Null when this view doesn't say.

expiresAt.description: When the story expires, or expired for a story kept in a highlight.

url.description: Link destination: the address the sticker opens, not Instagram's redirect.

displayUrl.description: Text shown on the sticker. Can be null on a profile's first lookup.

items.description: A link sticker on a story.

items.description: An Instagram account as it appears on other things.

mentions.description: Accounts mentioned. On a profile's first lookup, an account's `id`, `avatarUrl` and `verified` can be null.

shortcode.description: Shortcode of the shared post or Reel.

sharedMedia.description: The post or Reel the story re-shares. Null when none.

story.description: Story-only details. Null for posts and Reels.

items.description: An Instagram post, Reel or story.

media.description: One page of the Reels that use the audio, in Instagram's ranking for it (not chronological). Empty for an unknown id, and for audio with no Reels.

hasMore.description: Null when continuation is unknown for this page.

page.description: Pagination state. Pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page while `hasMore` is true.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier for tracing this API call.

version.description: Public API version that served the response.
